content.Title: 2024 Peripheral Artery Disease Guideline
content.Focus: Clinical guidelines for the diagnosis and management of Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD)
Sections Discussed: History and Physical Examination to Assess for PAD
Resting ABI and Additional Physiological Methods
General Guideline Points: Use of the Walking Impairment Questionnaire to assess lower extremity symptoms.
Validation of the WIfI Classification System for limb ischemia.
Consideration of ethnicity and peripheral artery disease in patient assessments.
